Description

Nespresso Vertuo Lattissima Coffee Machine ENV300

Café Quality Coffee At Home

Indulge in a wide range of barista-quality coffee recipes including milk coffees thanks to the integrated 0.5L milk carafe by De’Longhi.

One Touch Convenience

With just the touch of a button, the innovative Vertuo technology reads the capsule barcode to automatically deliver the perfect extraction and creamy, textured milk every time - so you can save time for what matters.

Easy To Use

The Vertuo Lattissima is delightfully easy to use thanks to its sleek design and intuitive interface. Plus, the state-of-the-art connectivity features keeps your machine up to date for a consistent coffee experience.

Simple Cleaning

The Vertuo Lattissima coffee machine is equipped with hassle-free descaling and cleaning functions. Plus, the milk carafe is detachable and dishwasher-safe.

Customise Your Coffee

Open a world of coffee choices like never before with Expert Mode. In this mode, your machine will concentrate the coffee extraction so you have the optimal coffee size for café strength milk beverages.

Sustainable

The energy saving function automatically turns off the machine after 2 minutes of inactivity, for your safety and peace of mind. In addition, all Nespresso pods can be easily recycled to give them a second life.

Premium Design

Vertuo Lattissima is an exclusive collaboration between two coffee industry titans, De’Longhi and Nespresso. This exciting fusion of Italian design and Swiss engineering has resulted in an exquisitely crafted coffee machine born from the best of both worlds. The Vertuo Lattissima is part of the Distinta Moments breakfast collection for a cohesive benchtop style.
